correctness_argument: Potel 2018 (Nature Methods 15:187, PXD008369) releases one per-record artifact, Supplementary Table 2: 2,129 phosphosites (S 1,220, T 501, Y 162, H 246) each with a MaxQuant summed-XIC intensity in 12 samples, a localization probability, the PEP, Andromeda score and delta score of the best phosphopeptide and a diagnostic-peak flag (measured by experiments/036-dataset-fixes-before-kg-build/scripts/potel2018_release_inventory.py). No served class can hold it (#921): none of the 21 Phenotype subclasses has a site, residue or modification field, and ProteinAbundancePhenotype is keyed by protein with a protein abundance as its number. A site intensity is the precursor signal of the phosphopeptides carrying one modified residue, so it moves with the site's occupancy AND its protein's abundance; storing it under a protein key in the abundance leaf would change what that leaf's number means (a Rule 3 meaning change) and put two quantities under one label. By Rule 6 the physical measurement is the same family as protein abundance (LC-MS/MS precursor intensity) but the released quantity differs in what it is keyed on and what it measures, so it is a SIBLING leaf, not a field on the abundance leaf and not a child of it. The schema has no proteome parent class; inserting one would change the bases of the served ProteinAbundancePhenotype (a closure change across six served proteome stores), so the new leaf is a direct Phenotype subclass beside it, and the test pins ProteinAbundancePhenotype.__bases__ unchanged. Everything added is additive: eight new classes, three new bindings, and one new member in each of the five unions/type maps that let L0 and the KG dispatch the new experiment pair. schema_impact reports 0 breaking; the five modified bindings re-stale 11 dev-store datasets through ExperimentType / the type maps (their records serialize identically). The leaf states only what the release determines: the 42 multi-gene sites are one key each, in the released order (proteins|residue|positions), never split; a released 0 (12,095 of 25,548 cells) is a typed not_quantified status, never a stored zero and never a dropped site; and the replicate unit, which the release states both ways (two SI legends say 'n=12 biological replicates', the reporting summary and the dissertation reprint say technical triplicates), is value-or-gap rather than a pick. Growth phase and harvest OD are sample fields on the leaf (the harvest_optical_density precedent of MicroarrayExpressionScorePhenotype), because Environment has no growth-phase slot and adding one would move every served closure.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Key each site as '<locus>_<residue><position>' in ProteinAbundancePhenotype (the issue's first sketch)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It changes what a served leaf's key and number mean (a protein -> a site, an abundance -> a site precursor signal), a Rule 3 meaning change, and pools two quantities under one label in six served proteome stores' leaf.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Insert a ProteomePhenotype parent above ProteinAbundancePhenotype, ProteinFoldChangePhenotype and the new leaf
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: It changes the bases of served classes, so every served proteome closure moves (breaking) for a grouping no query needs today; the DAG placement is stated in the docstrings and pinned by a test instead.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Store a released 0 as an intensity of 0.0, or drop the site from that sample's record
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: A MaxQuant 0 is 'not quantified', not zero phosphorylation; storing it as a value fabricates a measurement, and dropping it loses the site's identification for that sample. A typed status keeps both honest.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Split each multi-protein site into one key per gene
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: The search could not assign the peptide to one protein (e.g. tufA;tufB under one accession P0CE47); splitting would invent three measurements where the release made one.

alternatives_rejected.alternative: Put growth phase on Environment (or CultureEnvironment)
alternatives_rejected.why_rejected: Environment is in every served closure and CultureEnvironment in the chemogenomic ones; a new field there moves them all. The harvest point is part of the sample, which the leaf describes.
